methodology: Classification of crypto payment gateways by published custody model, per-transaction fee, KYC requirement, coin coverage, fiat settlement and Lightning support, from provider pricing pages and docs as of August 2026. The published study (study_cohort=true) covers 50 gateways; this is a living dataset that also lists additional verified gateways (study_cohort=false). Rows with verified=false could not have their fee confirmed on an official page. Custody is an editorial classification based on each provider docs.

field_dictionary.name: Provider name
field_dictionary.fee_pct: Standard advertised platform/processing fee, percent per transaction
field_dictionary.custody: custodial = provider wallet receives first; non-custodial = settles to a wallet the merchant controls; self-hosted = merchant runs the software; hybrid = depends on configuration
field_dictionary.kyc: Merchant KYC to start accepting: none | optional | required
field_dictionary.settlement_fiat: Whether the merchant can settle or withdraw to fiat currency
field_dictionary.notable: Short editorial note on what the provider is known for
field_dictionary.verified: true = fee confirmed on an official page or reputable source
field_dictionary.study_cohort: true = part of the published 50-gateway August 2026 study; false = additional gateway in the living dataset
